page.overview:
Who is Mallory Klaxton?

is an aging Dunmer sorcerer who serves as cook and chef at the Dreary Jug (later renamed Grelnok's Skull), which he owns collectively with Grelnok, Hoa, Slaughter, and Tavima. He is played by Taliesin Jaffe in Blackwood miniseries.

Mallory is an aging Dunmer with white hair and beard. Like all dark elves, he has dark greyish skin.

In his role as cook and chef, Mallory is generally quippy and distrusting. His often dark temperament leads Slaughter to comment, "Every dish you describe sounds like a threat."

At some point in Mallory's distant past ("an old past [he'd] like to forget"), he learned to use a lockpick. He is not on speaking terms with his family.
